notes.title: Enjoy Your Favorite Voice Actresses Pairing Off in MangaGamer's Latest Yuri Release - Lilycle Rainbow Stage!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/ffba246f7fa3958a97becf8544cdbf14565c7530.png

What began as series of a yuri drama CDs spanning six different couples has culminated in this expansive tale of sweet, heartwarming stories from girls in love!   

How would you like to follow along as their romances develop? Jump into the perspective of 15 different girls for a first hand experience of their relationships growing over time. Will the three newest characters, Tamaki, Yuno, and Saeka manage to resolve their complex feelings for each other? Who of the trio will end up together? 

Lilycle Rainbow Stage!!! also features an incredible selection of famous voice actresses being coupled together! Fans can enjoy the talents of Juri Kimura (Miyamori in Shirobako), MAO (Flip Flappers, Keijo), Haruka Terui (Yuki Yuna is a Hero, Brave Witches), Shiori Mikami (Attack on Titan, Yuru Yuri), Azumi Asakura (iDOLM@STER, High School DxD), Maaya Uchida (iDOLM@STER, Yamada-kun and the Seven Witches, Love Chunibyou & Other Delusions), Aya Uchida (Love Live!, Danganronpa 2, Kemono Friends), Rumi Okubo (Astolfo in Fate/Apocrypha, Chinatsu in Yuru Yuri), Aya Suzaki (Kill la Kill, Tamako Market), and more in this cute, slice-of-life about girls enjoying girls! 

You won't want to miss this gorgeous, colorful delight! Available this week for 20% off!

notes.title: The Stargazers Release and Steam Cards, Badges, and More!
notes.notes:
The Stargazers releases 5pm Nov4th,

I'd like to take a moment to update everyone to our plans for steam cards and achievements. Firstly we won't be having steam cards at launch, we'd like to take our time and make sure the steam cards, backgrounds and badges all have custom artwork, therefor steam cards will come in quickly after launch. We'll also be sharing the sketches and creation of these images on our social media, @Lupiesoft on Twitter.

This is similar to what we did with our other title, The Reject Demon: Toko 

And secondly we will not have achievements. It's our feeling at achievements in games aren't meaningful unless they're actual achievements and not something you unlock just by clearing a chapter. In the future we may have achievements for our games when they make sense, but for this game it doesn't.

And lastly, we hope you all enjoy Stargazers, it's a fun story told from three different perspectives, a fun adventure in space. We here at Studio Lupiesoft hope you all enjoy our game!
